## Website Update Plans -- MCP-Only Discovery (2026-09-13)

Owner-directed: connect to Kosmos-Oden via MCP only and find plans for website updates. Both MCP servers used; no SSH for data retrieval (only for mailbox mechanics).

### Discovery method

- Observatory gkos_navigation_discover (name_query="website"): 1 hit (FAC-Content-Workflow-Guide). name_query="web design": 0 hits. Path/title matching is too narrow for topic discovery.
- Kosmos-Oden search_notes: 39 hits for "website", 6 for "WordPress", 5 for "HTMX", 1 for "replatform", 1 for "frontend". Plus area enumeration: Websites-Clients (2 notes), LuSaur_Tech (58), Game_Dev (33), FAC (100+).
- get_note: retrieved full content for all 10 key plan documents. No server-side truncation. Largest was 59,511 chars.

### 7 distinct website update plans found

1. FAC Website Modernization (flarmored.org)
   Path: FAC/Technology/Website/2026-08-10_FAC_website_Redesign_ideas/FAC_Website_Modernization_Execution_Plan_Draft_v0.1.md (14,506 chars)
   Remove Elementor/Pro from WordPress. Replace with Gutenberg/Site Editor + custom block theme fac-realm + one modular plugin fac-platform. Server-rendered HTML + HTMX 2.x production / HTMX 4 beta staging. Defines FHAS 1.0 (FAC Hypermedia Architecture Specification, 9 rules). Code layout: themes/fac-realm + plugins/fac-platform with 12 modules. Priority: Stability -> Reliability -> Fidelity.
   Companion: FAC_HTMX_v4_Revamp_Ideas.md (16,918 chars) -- HTMX 4 v4.0.0-beta6 is real (July 23 2026), hx-multipart extension, scroll restoration, hx-ws rewrite. Production baseline HTMX 2.0.10.
   Redesign ideas: FAC website redesign idea 1 - claude.md -- site assessment citing broken events page, missing donate/support page, no social proof, redundant nav.

2. LuSaur Website Build (lusaur.com)
   Path: LuSaur_Tech/LuSaur_site_00/LUSAUR-WEB-BUILD-001-v1.1_Codex-Implementation-Brief.md (41,188 chars)
   Next.js 16.3.x + React + TypeScript strict + Tailwind CSS 4.3.x + HTMX 2.0.10 pinned. Three visual modes: The Citadel (corporate), The Command Grid (systems/governance), The Frontier (gaming/worlds). Static-first App Router with bounded HTMX fragments. Node 24 LTS. Full source-of-truth inspection protocol before touching repos.
   Spec: LuSaur_Tech_WebDesign_spec.md (20,634 chars) -- brand positioning "Technology for worlds that need rules." Three segments: Company/Parent, Systems (GKOS, Marshal/008, Kosmos, Hypatia), Worlds.

3. Marshall for WordPress 7.x (multi-site platform)
   Path: LuSaur_Tech/web-tech/2026-08-12_plugin/2026-08-12_plugin_build/Sol-Marshall-WordPress-7-Plugin-Build-Directive-v1.0.md (47,428 chars)
   Native WordPress 7.x visual-site construction system replacing Elementor Pro across 6 assessed websites. Plugin marshall + companion theme Marshall Canvas. Central containerized MCP gateway connecting AI agents to secured Agent API on each site. Elementor migration with automated inventory -> best-effort native-block conversion -> human visual-review queue. WordPress 7.0.4+, PHP 8.2+, HTMX 2.0.10, MCP spec 2026-07-28. Agents may auto-publish page/post content only; templates/forms/navigation/code require human approval.

4. STO WordPress + HTMX POC (sto.odenknight.com)
   Path: Game_Dev/STO/Sol-ODEN_STO_WORDPRESS_HTMX_POC_ARCHITECTURE_AND_BUILD_PLAN_2026-08-22.md (34,193 chars)
   Separate WordPress install at sto.odenknight.com on existing IONOS Web Hosting Premium. Plugin "Oden STO Knowledge Core" with custom post types, taxonomies, relational tables. Server-rendered PHP + HTMX + small Alpine.js. No Docker/VPS for first POC. Transferable deliverables: content schema, data interchange, importer rules, HTMX interaction designs.

5. STO BETTER Replatform (Django/Wagtail alternative)
   Path: Game_Dev/STO/Sol-STO_BETTER_REPLATFORM_ARCHITECTURE_AND_BUILD_PLAN_2026-08-22.md (59,511 chars)
   Django 5.2 LTS / Wagtail 7.4 LTS + PostgreSQL + HTMX + Alpine.js. Two deployment tracks: non-Docker (VPS + Ansible + Caddy + systemd) and Docker (OCI + Compose). Chosen over WordPress for STO BETTER due to structured queryable build/equipment data, revision history, server-side calculators, spreadsheet import/export.

6. FAC Secretary & Governance Center
   Path: FAC/Technology/Website/2026-08-24_Sol-FAC-Secretary-and-Governance-Center.md (55,694 chars)
   WordPress plugin fac-secretary v1.2.0-pilot for FAC governance operations. Centralized authorization, deny-by-default projections, protected downloads, classified content, dual approval for minutes, conflict exclusions, tamper-evident audit trail. WordPress 7.1, PHP 8.2+, HTMX 2.x. 10 corrections from v1.1. Build phases 1-5 as POC/Alpha, governance ratification at Phase 6 exit gate.

7. SolveEverything HTMX Reading Experience
   Path: Websites-Clients/Presentation-Layer/SolveEverything Smooth Reading Experience with HTMX upgrade.md (6,154 chars)
   HTMX persistent application shell with dynamic content swaps for document-driven publishing. Sidebar TOC + hx-get fragment loading + CSS view transitions. Note: pins HTMX 1.9.10, older than the 2.0.10 baseline other plans use.

### Cross-cutting observations

- HTMX 2.0.10 is the pinned production baseline across FAC modernization, LuSaur build, Marshall plugin, and STO POC. SolveEverything pins 1.9.10 (stale).
- WordPress 7.x is the CMS for 4 of 7 plans (FAC, Marshall, STO POC, FAC Secretary). LuSaur uses Next.js. STO BETTER uses Django/Wagtail.
- Marshall is the platform play: one plugin/theme system to replace Elementor across 6 websites, with an MCP gateway for agent-driven content. It subsumes the FAC modernization plugin pattern (fac-platform) if adopted across sites.
- All plans share the same engineering priority: Stability -> Reliability -> Fidelity.
- No plan references another plan. The FAC modernization and Marshall plugin overlap significantly (both replace Elementor with native blocks + HTMX) but neither cites the other. This is the kind of gap a cross-reference check would catch.

### MCP tool performance

- search_notes (lexical, title/alias/tag/path): effective for discovery with multi-term batching. 52 total hits across 5 terms.
- get_note: reliable full-content retrieval, no truncation, all 10 documents returned complete.
- gkos_navigation_discover: path/title matching only, found 1 of 39 files search_notes found. Better for structural enumeration with path_prefix than topic discovery.
- gkos_search: NOT USED (still returning GKOS_P6_AUTHORIZED_VIEW_CONFLICT from seq 21 connectivity test).

### No action required from peers

This is a discovery report. No code changes proposed. If claude or codex have context on whether Marshall supersedes fac-platform, or whether the STO BETTER Django plan and STO WordPress POC are competing or complementary, that would close the cross-reference gap.
